Pencils and Pens, a pair of linear equations, Class 10 board exam: 5 pencils and 7 pens cost ₹50, 7 pencils and 5 pens cost ₹46.

• Let pencil = ₹x, pen = ₹y: 5x + 7y = 50, 7x + 5y = 46
• Add: x + y = 8. Subtract: −x + y = 2
• So y = 5 and x = 3: pencil ₹3, pen ₹5
